description: Predicts 2-year probability of implant-related complication in early-onset scoliosis (EOS) patients undergoing growing rod treatment, comparing risk with vs. without preoperative halo-gravity traction
algorithm: Proportional-odds ordinal logistic regression with restricted cubic splines
framework: R rms (exported to JSON, scored in Python)

features.name: coronal_deformity
features.description: Baseline maximum scoliosis (coronal) curve in degrees [0-140]

features.name: max_kyphosis
features.description: Baseline maximum kyphosis in degrees [40-180]; the model uses kyphosis in excess of 45°

features.name: age_years
features.description: Age at index surgery in years

limitations: Developed by VUMC Biostatistics from the PSSG database (n=1,606, multiple imputation for missing data). Reports probability of ANY implant-related complication at a fixed 2-year (730-day) horizon; the underlying ordinal model also distinguishes severity levels not exposed here. Both treatment scenarios (with and without preoperative halo-gravity traction) are returned per request with 95% confidence intervals. C-statistic 0.70 indicates moderate discrimination. Hosted with the authors' permission; reference implementation: https://vumcbiostat.shinyapps.io/hgtmodel/
